in_marathi.name: Dhaneshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhaneshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhaneshwar is a Sanskrit name derived from two words: 'Dhan' meaning wealth and 'Isvar' meaning God or Lord. This name signifies the deity who is the bestower of wealth and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Dhaneshwar is an aspect of Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as holding a bag of gold coins in his hand.
